1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One hidden cause: distinguish a bead location using crossing probes.
1.natural_language: Probe numbered border ports to reveal beam responses. Mark the hidden beads, then seal the vault. H means absorbed; R means reflected back; a numbered exit pairs two ports. Beams turn away from a diagonally adjacent bead, with a direct hit taking priority. Any arrangement with the required bead count and identical behavior at every border port is accepted. Queries are counted for efficiency, with no query limit. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
